name: Jacobs Solutions
fiscalYearEnd: Friday closest to September 30 (FY2025 ended September 26, 2025; FY2026 ends about October 2, 2026)

logo.source: en.wikipedia.org infobox logo (Jacobs Engineering Group 2019 logo.svg; current Jacobs wordmark)

description: Jacobs sells engineering, design, consulting and program-management services to governments and large companies: water and environmental projects, transport and energy infrastructure, and factories for chip, life-sciences and other advanced manufacturing clients (Infrastructure & Advanced Facilities), plus PA Consulting, a UK-based innovation and transformation consultancy it now owns outright. Most work is billed on cost-reimbursable terms (68% of FY2025 revenue), so it is paid for staff time and costs plus a fee rather than carrying big fixed-price construction risk. Gross revenue includes costs passed through to clients (which rose sharply in FY2026), so management steers investors to net revenue, which excludes pass-through costs. Backlog was $28.9 billion at June 26, 2026.

gics.note: Conventional filing label: GICS Sector 'Industrials' and Sub-Industry 'Construction & Engineering' per Wikipedia 'List of S&P 500 companies' (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_S%26P_500_companies, read 2026-09-30). That list gives only Sector and Sub-Industry. SEC SIC code 1600 (Heavy Construction other than building) per EDGAR. The box overstates construction: Jacobs describes itself as consulting, design, engineering and program management, with only selective design-build and construction-management-at-risk.

hq.note: 1999 Bryan Street, Suite 3500, Dallas, TX 75201 (EDGAR business address)

employees.note: Workforce of about 43,000 worldwide, including about 1,800 contingent workers (FY2025 10-K)

businessLines.name: Infrastructure & Advanced Facilities (I&AF)
businessLines.how: Clients (governments, utilities, chip and pharma manufacturers) pay for professional staff time and project costs plus a fee under mostly cost-reimbursable contracts, with a minority fixed-price; revenue rises with billable headcount, project mix and pass-through costs, and margin comes from utilisation and project mix.
businessLines.description: End-to-end consulting, planning, architecture, design, engineering, project and program management and long-term operations for critical infrastructure, water and environmental, and life sciences and advanced manufacturing clients; selective progressive design-build and construction management at risk. Serves governments in the US, Europe, UK, Middle East and Asia Pacific and multinational private clients.

operatingProfit.note: Segment operating profit before corporate costs, restructuring and intangible amortisation; FY2024 $798.4M

businessLines.name: PA Consulting
businessLines.how: Corporate and government clients pay consulting fees for advisory and transformation engagements; its segment margin (about 22% in FY2025) is far above the engineering segment (about 8%).
businessLines.description: Global innovation and transformation consultancy with public sector clients (defence and security, public services, health and life sciences) and private clients. Jacobs completed the purchase of all remaining PA shares on March 20, 2026 for initial consideration of about GBP 1.21 billion (about GBP 997.6M cash plus 2,043,537 new Jacobs shares) plus GBP 75M due in fiscal 2028.

brands.name: PA Consulting
brands.share: 10.5% of FY2025 revenue and 23.6% of segment operating profit (computed)

whatsNext.text: GBP 75 million of additional PA Consulting consideration due in fiscal 2028, payable in shares, cash or a mix
FY2026 results (year ends about Oct 2, 2026) against raised guidance of adjusted EPS $7.20 to $7.30
